import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.io.PrintWriter

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val pw = PrintWriter(System.out)
    
    val f0 = "What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?"
    val s0 = "What are you doing while sending \""
    val s1 = "\"? Are you busy? Will you send \""
    val s2 = "\"?"
    
    val MAX = 100005
    val MAX2 = 1e18 + 10 // Long
    val dp = LongArray(MAX)
    dp[0] = f0.length.toLong()
    for (i in 1 until MAX) {
        if (dp[i-1] > MAX2 / 2) {
            dp[i] = MAX2.toLong()
        } else {
            dp[i] = dp[i-1] * 2 + s0.length + s1.length + s2.length
        }

    // Fast token reading
    val tokens = mutableListOf<String>()
    var tokenIndex = 0
    fun nextToken(): String {
        while (tokenIndex >= tokens.size) {
            val line = br.readLine()
            if (line == null) return ""
            tokens.clear()
            tokens.addAll(line.split(" "))
            tokenIndex = 0
        }
        return tokens[tokenIndex++]
    }
    
    fun nextInt(): Int = nextToken().toInt()
    fun nextLong(): Long = nextToken().toLong()
    
    val N = nextInt()

                break

            if (curK < dp[curN - 1]) {
                curN--
                continue
            }
            curK -= dp[curN - 1]
            if (curK < s1.length) {
                ans = s1[curK.toInt()]
                break
            }
            curK -= s1.length
            if (curK < dp[curN - 1]) {
                curN--
                continue
            }
            curK -= dp[curN - 1]
            ans = s2[curK.toInt()]
            break
        }
        sb.append(ans)
    }
    pw.println(sb.toString())
    pw.flush()
}
